title: Offline and Network Status
description: React to the browser going offline and back online, queue messages while offline and retry a failed request.

banner.online: The browser reports a network connection. Messages are sent straight away.
banner.offline: The browser reports no network connection. Messages will be queued and sent when the connection returns.

form.title: Send a message
form.explanation: Messages are sent when you are online. While offline they wait in the queue and are sent when the connection comes back.

queue.title: Queued messages:
queue.empty: No messages are waiting to be sent.

paused.offline: You are offline. Queued messages will be sent when the connection returns.
paused.network: Sending failed because the network could not be reached. Try again with "Send queued messages now".
paused.server: Sending failed because the server returned an error. Try again with "Send queued messages now".

sent.title: Sent messages:
sent.empty: No messages have been sent yet.

request.title: Service status
request.explanation: Request the service status. If the request fails, the error explains why and you can try again.

errors.offline: The request failed because the browser has no network connection.
errors.network: The request failed because the server could not be reached.

events.title: Connection events
events.explanation: Every change in the connection, with the time it happened.
